# ECOS Medicare Solutions — Colorado Medicare Enrollment

> ECOS Medicare Solutions is an independent Medicare insurance agency serving all 64 Colorado counties. Led by Darin Weidauer — a certified Gerontologist from USC's Davis School of Gerontology, MBA, Veteran, Registered Social Security Analyst, and licensed independent insurance agent. We provide free, unbiased Medicare guidance.

## About ECOS Medicare Solutions

ECOS Medicare Solutions helps Colorado residents navigate Medicare enrollment, compare Medicare Advantage and Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plans, and avoid costly penalties. Our service is always free — we are compensated by insurance carriers, not by consumers.

## Key Medicare Information (2026)

### Medicare Part A (Hospital Insurance)
- Premium: $0 for most beneficiaries (40+ quarters of work)
- Deductible: $1,736 per benefit period
- Days 61-90 coinsurance: $434/day
- Lifetime reserve days: $868/day
- SNF coinsurance (days 21-100): $217/day

### Medicare Part B (Medical Insurance)
- Standard premium: $202.90/month
- Annual deductible: $283
- Coinsurance: 20% of Medicare-approved amount

### Medicare Part C (Medicare Advantage)
- Many $0 premium plans available in Colorado
- Bundles Part A + Part B + usually Part D
- Often includes dental, vision, hearing, fitness benefits

### Medicare Part D (Prescription Drug Coverage)
- Maximum deductible: $615
- Annual out-of-pocket cap: $2,100
- Late enrollment penalty: 1% of national base beneficiary premium per uncovered month

### IRMAA 2026 (based on 2024 MAGI)
- Threshold begins at $109,000 (individual) / $218,000 (joint)
- Part B premiums range from $202.90 to $689.90/month
- Part D surcharges range from $0 to $91.00/month

### Medigap Plans in Colorado
- **Plan G**: Covers nearly all out-of-pocket costs after $283 Part B deductible. Most popular plan.
- **Plan N**: Lower premiums than Plan G, but includes up to $20 copay per office visit and up to $50 for ER visits not resulting in admission.

## Medicare Enrollment Periods
- **Initial Enrollment Period (IEP)**: 7-month window around 65th birthday
- **Annual Enrollment Period (AEP)**: October 15 – December 7
- **Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment (OEP)**: January 1 – March 31
- **General Enrollment Period (GEP)**: January 1 – March 31 (coverage starts July 1)
- **Special Enrollment Periods (SEP)**: Triggered by qualifying life events
